name: ehtravel
description: EHTravel (AERIA) — glassmorphic flight/hotel/car booking UI over a federated GraphQL supergraph that orchestrates the Duffel API via Apollo Connectors.

scripts.graphql:check: rover supergraph compose --config graphql/supergraph.yaml > /dev/null && echo '✓ supergraph composes'
scripts.build: echo 'Static front end — no build step (index.html + src/**). Router builds via graphql/Dockerfile.'
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run test

author: Ola McCartney
